raw_text: Indian intelligence agencies have flagged unusual training activity by Pakistan's Special Service Group at a facility near Kotli in Pakistan-administered Kashmir, barely 12 kilometres from the Line of Control. Commercial satellite imagery obtained by India Strategic shows temporary structures, enhanced troop movements, and logistics buildup inconsistent with routine training patterns. Sources said Northern Command has been alerted and surveillance along the Kotli-Poonch axis has been intensified.
clean_text: Indian intelligence flags unusual Pakistan SSG training near Kotli, 12km from LoC. Satellite imagery shows logistics buildup. Northern Command alerted, surveillance intensified.
